head.title: Cases
head.subtitle: Educator applications, suspicious activity and disputes. Every decision is logged.

apps.waitingSub: Oldest first. An approved educator can invite parents; they see children only once a parent shares.
apps.rejectBody: The applicant gets a Telegram message and can apply again. If you add a reason, the applicant sees it.
apps.emptyD: New applications appear here. To approve an educator you know in advance, use the form on the right.

pre.title: Pre-approve an educator
pre.sub: Enter a phone number: when its owner applies, the application is approved at once.
pre.notePh: e.g. a learning centre we know
pre.done: {phone} pre-approved. Their application opens at once.

v.phone: Enter the full number: +998 and 9 digits.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This entry no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do this.
errors.ALREADY_DECIDED: This application has already been decided. Refresh the page.
errors.PHONE_INVALID: This isn’t an Uzbek phone number.
errors.ALREADY_EDUCATOR: This number’s owner is already an approved educator.

states.noAccessTitle: This section isn’t open to you
states.noAccessBody: Only the trust & safety team decides on educator applications.
states.errBody: Applications and decisions are safe. Check your connection and try again.
